name: ACID 事务

Consistency.meaning: 事务前后数据满足所有约束

REPEATABLE_READ.phantom: 有(MVCC快照读防/当前读不防)

content.mysqlDefault: REPEATABLE READ, MVCC快照读解决幻读, 当前读用Next-Key Lock

threeProblems.nonRepeatable: 同事务两次读结果不同(update)
threeProblems.phantom: 同事务两次读行数不同(insert)

notes: ACID=undo原子+undo/redo一致+锁/MVCC隔离+redo持久; 四级: RU→RC(防脏)→RR(防不可重复/MySQL默认)→Serializable(全防)
